verdict.rationale: Figma documents a built-in 'Figma agent' that can generate design directions, create diagrams, edit images and search files, with teammates able to 'riff with the agent' in shared files. AI iteration is also built into the Make/Sites code editors, and AI credits are metered for teams. A community user describes using Figma's AI to summarize notes into slides, while another calls FigJam's AI tools 'really bad and often broken'; that report is general quality criticism rather than a concrete failure, so it lowers confidence and quality instead of creating a dispute. Missing for 10: in-depth docs on how tasks are delegated and how far the agent can act autonomously, and stronger independent hands-on corroboration that the agent completes delegated tasks reliably.
